title: Reader Chapter 26
hook: A reader-facing chapter under phase-1 review.

examples.title: Osias folds the visitor badge in half
examples.scenario: Osias touches a bent visitor badge at Friday 9:18 p.m. in outside room 512 at Mercy South, older brother, with a phone buzzing with his sister's texts. His mother is asleep behind the curtain. 'You always make the calls,' his sister says through the phone. Osias starts to answer about the discharge form, then feels the old sentence rising: because you never show up. Osias he has to say whether they are arguing about paperwork, fear, or being the good child.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.

examples.title: Yara watches the coffee skin over
examples.scenario: Yara touches a cold coffee cup at Monday 8:16 a.m. in the second-floor teachers' lounge, history teacher, with a group chat open on her laptop. A colleague's joke about her grading speed landed like a public swipe. Yara has three replies typed, each sharper than the last. The coffee has gone gray at the rim. Yara she has to decide whether to answer the impact as intent or ask what he meant in private.
examples.whyItMatters: It shows the skill in context.
